blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine Blu Girls saw their three-game winning streak snapped by unbeaten China with a 7-0 defeat in five innings on Thursday in women’s softball of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games. The Blu Girls could only produce two hits even as the Chinese bats went on a tear, capping things off with a four-run fifth that forced a quick end to the contest held at Anjo Softball Ground.
